mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies and a pleasant 76 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail, with a First Quarter moon shining down.

The city is currently recruiting an Engineering Technician to help manage municipal construction projects with a deadline to apply by September 20. Also, residents can now apply for the rain barrel rebate program to receive a credit on their utility bill by installing a qualifying 35-gallon barrel.

You have plenty to look forward to with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard happening today, the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow, and Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena this coming Saturday.
In our weekly report, on August 15, officers responded to a situation where a driver was found passed out behind the wheel and was later arrested for a first offence O W I.
Make sure to grab the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor today, which is available at Culvers until they close at 10:30 PM.
